subject: DI03009021

title.en: Power Generation through Solar and Wind

body.en:
Definition

A photovoltaic cell is a semiconductor device that converts incident light directly into DC electrical energy by the photovoltaic effect,without an intermediate heat-engine stage.

Classification / representative type

  • PV differs from concentrated solar thermal power. PV systems may be standalone,grid-connected or hybrid;cells form modules,strings and arrays.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Acell has semiconductor junction,front/back contacts and protective layers;incident photons create electron-hole pairs.
  2. Modules encapsulate interconnected cells with glass/backsheet or rear glass and frame;series connections raise voltage,parallel paths raise current.
  3. Mounting structures hold orientation and resist wind loads;roof suitability,access and shading are engineering design inputs.
  4. DCcabling,combiner arrangements,isolators and appropriately selected protection collect array output;earthing/bonding and surge protection follow the approved design.
  5. MPPT controls the operating point to obtain available maximum power;the inverter converts DC to ACwith the required waveform and control.
  6. ACprotection,metering and transformer where required connect the load/grid;standalone storage needs a compatible charge controller,battery and protective enclosure.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Light enters the semiconductor;absorbed photons create mobile carriers when suitable energy conditions are met.
  2. The junction field separates carriers and contacts collect them;closed external circuitry permits a DC current.
  3. Modules deliver a nonlinear voltage-current characteristic,so their output is not a fixed ideal voltage under all sunlight conditions.
  4. MPPT adjusts operating voltage/current as irradiance and temperature change;partial shading may cause mismatch losses.
  5. The inverter supplies compatible AC to a load or synchronises through approved grid controls;storage systems manage charging/discharging.
  6. Monitoring compares generated energy,irradiance and faults;availability of sunlight,not module nameplate alone,determines daily energy.

Applications

Rooftops,utility arrays,remote supplies and distributed generation.

Limitations and safety

Illuminated modules can remain live with ACoff. No rooftop climbing,DCconnector separation or grid wiring by students. Use approved miniature isolated modules and protected low-voltage loads.

PVneeds a steam turbine?

No;PVconverts light directly into DCelectrical energy.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Photovoltaic cell semiconductor device છે,જે photovoltaic effectથી પડતા પ્રકાશને intermediate heat-engine વિના સીધો DC electrical energyમાં ફેરવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • PV અને concentrated solar thermal power અલગ છે.PV system standalone,grid-connected કે hybrid હોઈ શકે;cellsથી modules,strings તથા arrays બને.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. Cellમાં semiconductor junction,front/back contacts તથા protective layers હોય;photons electron-hole pairs બનાવે.
  2. Modules interconnected cellsને glass/backsheet કે rear glass/frameમાં encapsulate કરે;seriesથી voltage,parallelથી current વધે.
  3. Mounting structures orientation રાખે/wind loads સહે;roof suitability,access/shading design inputs છે.
  4. DC cabling,combiner,isolator તથા યોગ્ય protection array output એકત્ર કરે;earthing/bonding/surge protection approved design મુજબ હોય.
  5. MPPT ઉપલબ્ધ maximum power માટે operating point ગોઠવે;inverter DCને જરૂરી waveform/control સાથે ACમાં ફેરવે.
  6. AC protection,metering/જરૂરી transformer load/grid જોડે;standalone storage માટે compatible controller,battery/protective enclosure જોઈએ.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Light semiconductorમાં પડે;યોગ્ય energy conditionsમાં absorbed photons mobile carriers બનાવે.
  2. Junction field carriers અલગ કરે;contacts collect કરે અને external closed circuitમાં DC current મળે.
  3. Modulesની voltage-current characteristic nonlinear છે;બધા sunlight conditionsમાં ideal fixed voltage મળતું નથી.
  4. Irradiance/temperature બદલાય ત્યારે MPPT voltage/current ગોઠવે;partial shadingથી mismatch loss થાય.
  5. Inverter loadને compatible AC આપે કે approved controlsથી grid synchronise કરે;storage system charging/discharging ગોઠવે.
  6. Monitoring generated energy,irradiance/faultsની સરખામણી કરે;daily energy sunlightથી નક્કી થાય,માત્ર nameplateથી નહીં.

ઉપયોગ

Rooftops,utility arrays,remote supply તથા distributed generation.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

AC off હોય તોપણ પ્રકાશવાળા modules live રહી શકે.વિદ્યાર્થી roof climbing,DC connector separation કે grid wiring નકરે.Approved miniature isolated module/protected low-voltage load લો.

PVને Steam turbine જોઈએ?

નહીં;PV lightને સીધું DC electrical energyમાં ફેરવે.

body.en:
Definition

A grid-connected rooftop PV system operates in parallel with the utility through approved inverter,protection and metering;ordinary grid-tied operation does not automatically provide backup during an outage.

Explanation and application

  • Construction:roof array→DCcollection/protection→grid-interactive inverter→ACprotection→metering/interface→building/grid. Anti-islanding is an essential protective function,not optional energy storage.
  • Working:array DC is tracked by MPPT,inverter follows approved grid voltage/frequency conditions,and local loads use energy with import/export according to controls and permissions.
  • During grid failure a normal grid-following inverter ceases grid energisation. Approved backup requires a suitable hybrid/backup design and safe separation,not bypassing anti-islanding.
  • Benefits include reduced daytime imports and little battery maintenance in a storage-free system. Limits include roof/shade constraints,intermittency and utility interconnection rules.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Grid-connected rooftop PV approved inverter,protection/metering દ્વારા utility સાથે parallel ચાલે;ordinary grid-tied operationથી outageમાં automatic backup મળતું નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Construction:roof array→DC collection/protection→grid-interactive inverter→AC protection→metering/interface→building/grid. Anti-islanding essential protection છે,optional storage નહીં.
  • Working:MPPT array DC track કરે;inverter approved grid voltage/frequency અનુસરે;controls/permission મુજબ local loads તથા import/export થાય.
  • Grid failure વખતે normal grid-following inverter grid energisation બંધ કરે.Approved backup માટે suitable hybrid/backup design/safe separation જોઈએ;anti-islanding bypass નહીં.
  • Storage વગર daytime import ઘટે/battery maintenance ઓછું હોય.મર્યાદા:roof/shade,intermittency તથા utility rules.

h.en: Standalone rooftop PV and sizing illustration
h.gu: Standalone rooftop PV તથા Sizing illustration

body.en:
Definition

A standalone PV system supplies its designated loads without requiring a utility grid connection;storage or other backup is needed when supply must continue without sunlight.

Explanation and application

  • Construction:array,charge controller,protected battery,DCdistribution and inverter for ACloads;all ratings and battery-management requirements must be compatible.
  • Working:sunlight supplies loads and charges storage within controller limits;when PV falls,the battery supplies loads until the permitted discharge limit. Backup/generator integration needs an approved control scheme.
  • Illustration:daily load1.2kWh,assumed peak-sun-hours4h and total energy-yield factor0.75 require1.2/(4×0.75)=0.4kWp minimum on this simplified energy basis. This is not a complete array/inverter design.
  • For1day autonomy,12Vnominal battery,usable fraction0.5 and assumed discharge-path efficiency0.9:C=1200/(12×0.5×0.9)=222.22Ah. Rating,temperature,ageing,charge rate and manufacturer limits must also be checked.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Standalone PV utility connectionની જરૂર વિના designated loadsને supply આપે;sunlight વગર ચાલુ supply માટે storage/other backup જોઈએ.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Construction:array,charge controller,protected battery,DC distribution તથા AC loads માટે inverter;ratings/battery-management compatible હોવા જોઈએ.
  • Working:sunlight loadsને supply આપી controller limitsમાં storage charge કરે;PV ઘટે ત્યારે battery permitted discharge limit સુધી loads આપે.Backup/generator માટે approved control scheme જોઈએ.
  • Illustration:daily load1.2kWh,ધારેલા peak-sun-hours4h તથા energy-yield factor0.75થી1.2/(4×0.75)=0.4kWp minimum મળે.આ simplified energy basis છે,complete array/inverter design નહીં.
  • 1day autonomy,12V nominal battery,usable fraction0.5 તથા discharge-path efficiency0.9 ધારો:C=1200/(12×0.5×0.9)=222.22Ah. Rating,temperature,ageing,charge rate/manufacturer limits પણ તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

A wind turbine converts a portion of the kinetic-energy flux of moving air into rotor mechanical power,which a generator converts into electrical power.

Explanation and application

  • Air remains moving downstream;extracting all wind kinetic energy would stop flow and prevent a steady through-flow. The turbine power coefficient is therefore bounded.
  • Rotor→shaft→optional gearbox→generator→converter/protection→transformer/grid is the electrical energy path.
  • Wind speed varies in time and with height;nameplate MW is not a continuous guaranteed output. Forecasting and system balancing accommodate variability.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Wind turbine વહેતી હવાના kinetic-energy fluxના ભાગને rotor mechanical powerમાં ફેરવે;generator તેને electrical powerમાં ફેરવે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Downstream હવા હજી ચાલે છે;આખી kinetic energy કાઢતાં flow અટકે/steady through-flow નરહે.તેથી power coefficient મર્યાદિત છે.
  • Rotor→shaft→optional gearbox→generator→converter/protection→transformer/grid એ energy path છે.
  • Wind speed સમય/heightથી બદલાય;nameplate MW સતત guaranteed output નથી.Forecasting/system balancing variability સંભાળે.

body.en:
Definition

Wind generation is renewable kinetic-energy conversion whose usefulness depends on resource quality,availability,grid connection and lifecycle impacts.

Explanation and application

  • Advantages:no fuel purchase during operation,low direct operational emissions,modular additions and possible coexistence with suitable agriculture between turbines.
  • Limitations:variable output,site-specific wind,transmission needs,noise/visual concerns,wildlife impacts and specialised maintenance at height.
  • Wind farms need micro-siting,wake spacing,access,geotechnical design and grid studies;simply placing turbines close together can reduce yield through wakes.
  • Grid integration may use reserves,storage,demand flexibility and geographical diversity;wind MWalone does not replace an equal amount of firm capacity under all conditions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Wind generation renewable kinetic-energy conversion છે;ઉપયોગિતા resource quality,availability,grid connection/lifecycle impacts પર આધારિત છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • ફાયદા:operationમાં fuel ખરીદી નહીં,low direct operational emissions,modular additions તથા turbines વચ્ચે suitable agriculture શક્ય.
  • મર્યાદા:variable output,site-specific wind,transmission,noise/visual concerns,wildlife impacts તથા height પર specialised maintenance.
  • Wind farmમાં micro-siting,wake spacing,access,geotechnical design/grid study જોઈએ;ખૂબ નજીક turbinesથી wake losses વધે.
  • Reserves,storage,demand flexibility/geographical diversity integrationમાં મદદ કરે;wind MW દરેક સ્થિતિમાં સમાન firm capacity replace કરતું નથી.

title.en: 3.5 Why a wind rotor rotates:lift and drag
title.gu: 3.5 Wind rotor કેમ ફરે:Lift તથા Drag

h.en: Why a wind rotor rotates:lift and drag
h.gu: Wind rotor કેમ ફરે:Lift તથા Drag

body.en:
Definition

Lift is the aerodynamic force perpendicular to relative airflow;drag is the force parallel to it. The useful tangential component of blade force produces rotor torque.

Explanation and application

  • An airfoil sees relative wind combining incoming air and blade motion;its angle of attack determines lift/drag behaviour.
  • HAWT blades are twisted along radius because blade speed changes with radius. Pitch control adjusts blade angle to regulate power and loads.
  • Lift-based designs generally achieve higher tip-speed ratios than drag-based designs. A Savonius rotor mainly uses differential drag;Darrieus-type VAWTs are lift-driven.
  • Excess angle of attack can cause stall;the force is not explained correctly by saying the wind only pushes the back of every modern blade.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Lift relative airflowને perpendicular aerodynamic force છે;drag parallel force છે.Blade forceનો ઉપયોગી tangential component rotor torque આપે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Airfoil માટે incoming air/blade motionનું સંયોજન relative wind છે;angle of attackથી lift/drag behaviour નક્કી થાય.
  • Radius મુજબ blade speed બદલાતી હોવાથી HAWT blades twisted હોય.Pitch control blade angle ગોઠવી power/loads regulate કરે.
  • Lift-based designs સામાન્ય drag-based કરતાં higher tip-speed ratio આપે.Savonius મુખ્યત્વે differential dragથી અને Darrieus-type VAWT liftથી ચાલે.
  • વધુ angle of attackથી stall થાય;બધી modern bladesને માત્ર wind પાછળથી ધક્કો આપે એમ સમજાવવું ખોટું છે.

body.en:
Definition

Power coefficient Cp is extracted rotor mechanical power divided by available upstream wind power through the swept area;it is not the same as generator efficiency.

Explanation and application

  • HAWT swept area A=πD²/4;for a simple straight-bladed VAWT,the projected swept area is approximately rotor height×diameter. Use the appropriate geometry.
  • Cut-in speed:lowest specified wind speed at which generation begins. Rated speed:wind speed at which rated output is first reached under specified conditions.
  • Cut-out speed:high wind speed at which operation is stopped/protected to limit loads;exact values are manufacturer/design-specific,not universal constants.
  • Tip-speed ratio λ=ωR/v compares blade-tip speed with undisturbed wind speed. Betzideal limit Cp≤16/27≈0.593;actual electrical output also includes drivetrain/generator/converter losses.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Power coefficient Cp એટલે swept areaમાંથી પસાર available upstream wind power સામે extracted rotor mechanical powerનો ગુણોત્તર;તે generator efficiency નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • HAWT માટે swept area A=πD²/4;simple straight-bladed VAWTમાં projected area આશરે rotor height×diameter છે.યોગ્ય geometry લો.
  • Cut-in speed:specified સૌથી ઓછી speed જ્યાં generation શરૂ થાય.Rated speed:specified conditionsમાં પ્રથમ rated output મળતી speed.
  • Cut-out speed:loads મર્યાદિત કરવા high wind પર operation stop/protect થાય તે speed;values manufacturer/design-specific છે,universal નહીં.
  • Tip-speed ratio λ=ωR/v blade-tip/undisturbed wind speed સરખાવે.Betz ideal limit Cp≤16/27≈0.593;actual electric outputમાં drivetrain/generator/converter losses પણ આવે.

h.en: Wind power derivation and cubic-speed example
h.gu: Wind power derivation તથા Cubic-speed ઉદાહરણ

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Assume uniform steady wind,ρ=1.225kg/m³,D=40m,v=8m/s,Cp=0.4 and total post-rotor efficiency0.9.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Air volume crossing area A in time Δt is AvΔt,so mass flow ṁ=ρAv.
  2. Kinetic energy per unit mass=v²/2;Pwind=ṁv²/2=ρAv³/2.This is available wind power,not turbine output.
  3. Rotor power=CpPwind;electrical power=ηCpρAv³/2.A=π×40²/4=1256.637m².
  4. Pwind≈394.081kW;rotor≈157.632kW;electric≈141.869kW. At10m/s with unchanged Cp/η,the ratio is(10/8)³=1.953125,but rated-power controls may limit real output.

Interpretation and check

The cubic relation does not predict unlimited output above rated speed,and density/velocity assumptions must be stated.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Uniform steady wind,ρ=1.225kg/m³,D=40m,v=8m/s,Cp=0.4 તથા total post-rotor efficiency0.9 ધારો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. સમય Δtમાં area Aમાંથી air volume AvΔt જાય,તેથી mass flow ṁ=ρAv.
  2. Unit massની kinetic energy=v²/2;Pwind=ṁv²/2=ρAv³/2.આ available wind power છે,turbine output નહીં.
  3. Rotor power=CpPwind;electrical power=ηCpρAv³/2.A=π×40²/4=1256.637m².
  4. Pwind≈394.081kW;rotor≈157.632kW;electric≈141.869kW.10m/s પર Cp/η અચળ હોય તો ratio(10/8)³=1.953125 છે,પણ actual output rated-power controlથી મર્યાદિત થઈ શકે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Cubic relation rated speed ઉપર અમર્યાદિત output બતાવતી નથી;density/velocity assumptions લખો.

title.gu: 3.7 Wind turbine types:HAWT તથા VAWT Construction

h.gu: Wind turbine types:HAWT તથા VAWT Construction

body.en:
Definition

HAWThas a rotor axis approximately parallel to the wind direction;VAWThas a predominantly vertical rotor axis,usually transverse to horizontal wind.

Explanation and application

  • HAWT construction:airfoil blades attach to a hub,main shaft/bearings and nacelle on a tower. The nacelle houses geared or direct-drive equipment;pitch actuators change blade angle and yaw turns the nacelle toward the wind.
  • HAWT working:lift creates rotor torque,the shaft drives the generator,and converter/grid controls deliver compatible output. Wind sensing,braking and pitch/yaw control keep operation in the designed envelope.
  • VAWT construction:vertical shaft with support arms holds straight/curved Darrieus blades or Savonius buckets. Bearings,supports and generator complete the drivetrain;some arrangements locate heavy equipment nearer ground level.
  • VAWT working:wind from different horizontal directions can act without a HAWT-style yaw system. Lift/drag produces torque about the vertical axis;cyclic loading and starting behaviour depend on rotor type.
  • Comparison:large commercial farms commonly use HAWTfor mature high-output designs;VAWTmay suit specialised conditions but is not automatically more efficient or self-starting. Darrieus may need starting assistance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

HAWTમાં rotor axis આશરે wind directionને parallel હોય;VAWTમાં axis મુખ્યત્વે vertical હોય,સામાન્ય horizontal windને transverse.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • HAWT construction:airfoil blades hub,main shaft/bearings તથા tower પર nacelle સાથે જોડાય.Nacelleમાં geared/direct-drive equipment હોય;pitch actuator blade angle બદલે,yaw nacelleને wind તરફ ફેરવે.
  • HAWT working:liftથી torque મળે,shaft generator ચલાવે અને converter/grid controls compatible output આપે.Wind sensing,braking/pitch/yaw designed envelope જાળવે.
  • VAWT construction:vertical shaft/support arms પર straight/curved Darrieus blades કે Savonius buckets હોય.Bearings,supports/generator drivetrain પૂર્ણ કરે;કેટલીક ગોઠવણમાં heavy equipment ground પાસે હોય.
  • VAWT working:અલગ horizontal directionથી wind HAWT જેવી yaw system વિના કામ કરે.Lift/drag vertical axis આસપાસ torque આપે;cyclic loading/starting rotor type મુજબ બદલાય.
  • Comparison:મોટા commercial farmsમાં mature high-output HAWT સામાન્ય છે;VAWT specialised સ્થિતિમાં ચાલે,પણ આપોઆપ વધુ efficient/self-starting નથી.Darrieusને starting assistance જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

A geared drivetrain increases rotor speed mechanically before the generator;direct drive couples the rotor to a low-speed generator without a main speed-increasing gearbox.

Explanation and application

  • Geared construction:rotor/hub→main bearing/low-speed shaft→gearbox→high-speed shaft/coupling→generator,with lubrication,cooling,brake and control equipment. The gearbox trades low-speed high torque for higher-speed lower torque.
  • Geared working:wind torque rotates the rotor;the ratio raises generator speed and electrical conversion follows through the chosen generator/converter scheme. Gear and bearing losses plus maintenance must be considered.
  • Direct-drive construction:rotor and main bearing directly drive a large multi-pole low-speed generator;full converter,cooling,braking and structural support are commonly required.
  • Direct-drive working:many poles produce electrical frequency at lower mechanical speed;the converter decouples variable generator frequency from the fixed grid frequency. No gearbox does not mean no losses,no bearings or no maintenance.
  • For either arrangement,the tower/foundation,pitch/yaw,wind sensors,collection cables,transformer and protection remain essential;direct drive and variable speed are related choices,not identical definitions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Geared drivetrain generator પહેલાં rotor speed mechanically વધારે;direct drive main speed-increasing gearbox વિના low-speed generator જોડે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Geared construction:rotor/hub→main bearing/low-speed shaft→gearbox→high-speed shaft/coupling→generator સાથે lubrication,cooling,brake/control. Gearbox low-speed high torqueને higher-speed lower torqueમાં ફેરવે.
  • Geared working:wind torque rotor ફેરવે;ratio generator speed વધારે,પછી selected generator/converter schemeથી વીજળી મળે.Gear/bearing losses તથા maintenance ગણો.
  • Direct-drive construction:rotor/main bearing સીધું large multi-pole low-speed generator ચલાવે;સામાન્ય રીતે full converter,cooling,braking/structural support જોઈએ.
  • Direct-drive working:ઘણા polesથી ઓછી mechanical speed પર electrical frequency મળે;converter variable generator frequencyને fixed grid frequencyથી અલગ રાખે.No gearbox એટલે no losses/bearings/maintenance નહીં.
  • બંનેમાં tower/foundation,pitch/yaw,wind sensors,collection cables,transformer/protection જરૂરી;direct drive/variable speed સંબંધિત choices છે,સમાન definition નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A generation scheme states how mechanical speed and electrical output frequency are related and how the load/grid requirements are met.

Explanation and application

  • Constant-speed constant-frequency:approximately fixed rotor speed and grid frequency,commonly with a grid-connected induction generator. A small slip range exists;it is not exactly one unchanging speed at all loads.
  • Variable-speed constant-frequency:rotor speed changes with wind while power electronics deliver fixed-frequency grid power. Full-converter machines process full power;DFIG uses a different partial-converter arrangement with direct stator grid connection.
  • Variable-speed variable-frequency:generator output frequency changes with speed and feeds a compatible isolated load or subsequent conversion stage. It cannot be connected directly to a fixed-frequency grid regardless of synchronisation.
  • For a synchronous machine f=Pn/120,with poles P and speed n in rpm;therefore variable n gives variable f before electronic conversion. Gear ratio changes n,but does not itself regulate grid frequency.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Generation scheme mechanical speed/electrical output frequencyનો સંબંધ તથા load/grid requirement કેવી રીતે પૂરી થાય તે બતાવે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Constant-speed constant-frequency:આશરે fixed rotor speed/grid frequency,સામાન્ય grid-connected induction generator સાથે.Small slip range હોય;બધા loads પર એકદમ અચળ speed નહીં.
  • Variable-speed constant-frequency:wind સાથે rotor speed બદલાય,પણ power electronics fixed-frequency grid power આપે.Full-converter full power process કરે;DFIGમાં direct stator grid connection તથા partial converterની અલગ ગોઠવણ છે.
  • Variable-speed variable-frequencyમાં output frequency speedથી બદલાય;તે compatible isolated load કે subsequent converterને મળે.Synchronisation અવગણી fixed-frequency grid પર સીધું નજોડી શકાય.
  • Synchronous machine માટે f=Pn/120,જ્યાં poles P અને speed n rpmમાં છે;તેથી electronic conversion પહેલાં variable nથી variable f મળે.Gear ratio n બદલે,પોતે grid frequency regulate કરતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Wind-farm gross capacity is the sum of turbine nameplate ratings within a defined project boundary;equity capacity and whole-region capacity are different quantities.

Explanation and application

  • CLP/Apraava reference:Samana in Jamnagar100.8MW,formed by two50.4MW phases;Mahidad in Gujarat50.4MW commissioned2014.Do not merge these with another developer’s nearby farm.[1](https://www.clpindia.in/operations_wind.html)
  • CLPGroup Mahidad page explicitly distinguishes gross50.4MW from equity25.2MW at50%interest;for a station-nameplate list use gross,not the ownership share.[2](https://www.clpgroup.com/en/about/our-business/assets-and-services/india/mahidad-wind-farm.html)
  • Tata Samana is separately documented as50.4MW with63turbines of800kW commissionedMay2009;the shared place-name does not mean the CLPand Tata project capacities are duplicates.[3](https://evwind.aeeolica.org/2013/02/19/tata-power-registers-its-50-4mw-wind-energy-project-at-samana-gujarat-under-the-clean-development-mechanism/29436)
  • These named documented examples are not an exhaustive latest Gujarat ranking. Record developer,boundary,date,MW and evidence;annual generation requires MWh/MUdata,not nameplate alone.

Collect timestamped solar,wind and other renewable output from authoritative datasets;keep project,region,time zone,averaging interval and units explicit. Aforecast is not measured output.

  1. Prepare approximately five pages with aim,scope and source/date details;use the source requirement,not invented visit evidence.

  2. Genuine permitted evidence લો;original units,timestamps/data boundaries રાખો;દરેક external capacity/generation claim cite કરો.
  3. Comparison table/labelled diagram બનાવો;assumptions,missing records/safety limits સમજાવો.
  4. Actual collected datasetથી જ report calculation કરો;synthetic examples/measured data અલગ રાખો.
  5. Engineering interpretation,limitations,references/evidence appendix આપો;signatures/certificates નબનાવો.

ખાલી Record fields

Station/project | unit boundary | source URL | source date | timestamp/time zone | interval | MW કે MWh/MU | status | evidence filename. Data મળ્યા સુધી values blank.
